verdict.rationale: Programmatic TOTP retrieval is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows codes being viewed in the mobile app and typed in manually. No CLI or API is documented, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The Screen Capture setting only allows screenshots of the app screen, which is an adjacent feature, not programmatic access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can fetch a current TOTP code programmatically — via CLI or API — to complete a 2FA login inside an automated workflow
